story.text: Saudi Arabia beat Argentina 2-1 in the Group Stage of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Argentina had more of the ball (70 percent to 30 percent), and Argentina also created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (2.28 to 0.20). The goals came from Lionel Messi at 9:15 (penalty), Saleh Al Shehri at 47:40 and Salem Al Dawsari at 52:44.
